node-1.label: Shortness of breath and fatigue on exertion for one week

node-2.label: Patient is an 84-year-old man with medical history of permanent atrial fibrillation on warfarin therapy for more than 15 years, hypertension, and obstructive sleep apnea.

node-3.label: Patient used a walker for ambulation and had a mechanical fall two years ago with a T12 vertebral fracture requiring orthopedic intervention, with no falls since then.

node-4.label: Medications included metoprolol, amlodipine, and over-the-counter acetaminophen.

node-5.label: Physical examination: blood pressure 140/80 mm Hg, pulse irregular at 130 beats/min, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation normal, jugular venous pressure estimated at 10 cm, heart sounds demonstrated variable intensity of S1 and S2, no murmurs, gallops, or rubs appreciated, remainder unremarkable.
